workflows.title: Invoice Processing with 3-Way Match
workflows.ask: Set up an agent that reads supplier invoices from email, matches them to purchase orders and goods receipts, and posts approved ones to our ERP
human_gates: Exception review by AP clerk before posting to ERP because it involves money and an irreversible write to the financial system

loops.what: Re-extract fields when deterministic arithmetic check fails

workflows.volume: 500 runs per day for a mid-size retailer receiving daily supplier invoices
workflows.outcome: 92% touchless invoice processing achieved, targeting ~99%; manual effort reduced significantly. Source: https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/what-we-do/case-studies/hands-off-the-task-eyes-on-the-outcome.html
traps: Do not use AgentBay (closed to new customers); use agent-sandbox instead
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base or zero-code apps for new international accounts; use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage
Do not use qwen3.5-ocr in Singapore; use qwen-vl-ocr
Do not enable thinking mode if extracting strict JSON schema
Do not draw inbound email as DirectMail; it arrives via EventBridge HTTP webhook

workflows.title: Contract Clause Review and Redlining
workflows.ask: Build a workflow that extracts clauses from uploaded contracts, compares them against our legal playbook, and drafts redlines for lawyer approval
human_gates: Lawyer must approve every redline suggestion because it carries legal effect and binds the company to contractual terms

loops.what: Evaluator loop: second model grades drafted redlines for unsupported claims or missing caveats

workflows.volume: 50 runs per day for a mid-size enterprise legal department
workflows.outcome: 37% average time savings across agreement-management activities. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/new-deloitte-study-shows-that-ai-powered-agreement-management-is-paying-off-302743916.html
traps: Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox for any code execution
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector
Do not use AI Search Open Platform (no Singapore region)
qwen-long is legacy and does not support function calling or built-in tools; use qwen3.8-max for reasoning steps
Do not use China-only managed-agent Tool Approval for HITL; use framework-level interrupt or CloudFlow callback

workflows.title: KYC and Customer Onboarding Triage
workflows.ask: Create an onboarding agent that verifies customer IDs, screens them against sanctions lists, and routes high-risk profiles to a compliance officer

steps.label: Application submitted via web form webhook
Verify ID document and selfie liveness
Screen against sanctions and PEP lists
Risk rating and SoW narrative synthesis
Route SDD/CDD/EDD based on risk score
Translate status update to customer language

human_gates: MLRO/compliance officer must manually approve medium and high-risk cases due to legal effect, regulatory obligations under MAS Notice 626, and automated-decision rights under GDPR Art. 22 and Korea PIPA Art. 37-2

loops.what: Re-capture document if ZOLOZ rejects authenticity or OCR confidence is too low

workflows.volume: 200 runs per day for a mid-size regional bank
workflows.outcome: Agentic AI can reduce KYC processing times by 30–70%. Source: https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/risk-and-resilience/our-insights/how-agentic-ai-can-change-the-way-banks-fight-financial-crime
traps: Do not use general VLM for identity verification; use ZOLOZ Real ID
Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage
Do not draw KakaoTalk or Zalo as Chat App channels; they are not supported internationally
Telephony is not established internationally; do not draw a phone trigger, use webhook only

workflows.title: Insurance Claims FNOL Triage and Settlement
workflows.ask: Set up an agent that ingests first notice of loss emails, extracts medical and repair documents, determines coverage, and queues settlements for adjuster approval

steps.label: Create claim shell in admin system
Classify line of business and severity
OCR medical bills and repair quotes
Adjuster reviews coverage decision and quantum

human_gates: Adjuster must review coverage decisions and settlement amounts because coverage denial has legal/regulatory effect and payment involves money and irreversible writes

loops.what: Missing-document chase: request additional evidence from customer and wait for upload
loops.exit: max 3 requests or all required documents received

workflows.volume: 300 runs per day for a mid-size insurer
workflows.outcome: Complex-case liability assessment time cut by 23 days; routing accuracy improved by 30%. Source: https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/tech-and-ai/how-we-help-clients/rewired-the-insurance-claims-journey-with-ai
traps: Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage
Do not let the LLM compute settlement math; use Function Compute for deterministic arithmetic
Do not use Paraformer ASR if voice FNOL is added later; it is deprecated, use Fun-ASR or Qwen-ASR
Do not use AI Search Open Platform; no Singapore region

workflows.title: Financial Report Analysis and Summarisation
workflows.ask: Build an analyst assistant that parses quarterly PDF reports, computes financial ratios in code, and drafts summary memos for human sign-off

steps.label: Annual report PDF uploaded to OSS
Segment document into MD&A, statements, notes
Compute growth rates and margins in Python
Retrieve prior periods and peer filings
Draft analyst memo with inline citations

human_gates: Analyst must verify every number before publication because outputs may feed investment or credit decisions carrying legal and regulatory implications

loops.what: Evaluator loop: second model grades memo for hallucinated numbers or misstated direction of change

workflows.volume: 20 runs per month during earnings season for a mid-size investment firm
workflows.outcome: LLMs achieved 60% accuracy predicting directional earnings changes one month after filing vs 53% for human analysts. Source: https://arxiv.org/html/2407.17866v2
traps: Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector
Do not let the LLM do arithmetic; always use Function Compute or Code Interpreter
Do not use qwen-long for function calling or built-in tools; it is legacy and unsupported for those features
Batch inference in Singapore excludes qwen3.8-max text-only input; check per model

workflows.title: Regulatory Change Monitoring and Impact Assessment
workflows.ask: Set up a daily job that crawls regulator feeds, translates new rules, maps them to our policies, and drafts impact memos for the compliance owner to approve

steps.label: Daily scheduled crawl of regulator feeds
Map to internal policies and controls
Draft impact memo and proposed redlines
Compliance owner confirms or rejects assessment
Create remediation tasks in GRC tracker

human_gates: Compliance owner must confirm the impact assessment because incorrect mapping creates legal/regulatory exposure and drives binding remediation commitments

loops.what: Re-scan for remediation status and escalate overdue items
loops.exit: runs daily until task is closed

workflows.volume: ~200 alerts per day globally, filtered down to 5-10 relevant runs per day for a specific institution. Basis: Thomson Reuters 2023 Cost of Compliance report cites ~200 international regulatory changes captured daily.
traps: Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage
Use qwen-mt-plus/flash/lite for translation, not a general LLM which is more expensive and less controllable
Do not use AI Search Open Platform; no Singapore region
Web search costs $10 per 1,000 calls in Singapore; count tool calls in cost estimates

workflows.title: Multilingual Document Localisation Pipeline
workflows.ask: Create a pipeline that translates product documentation into six languages, scores quality automatically, and routes low-confidence segments to human translators

steps.label: Human post-editing for low-QE or regulated segments
Write back to TM and publish to CMS

human_gates: Human post-editing required for low-quality scores and legally regulated content because machine translation alone is insufficient for legal/medical/regulatory text

loops.what: Feedback from LQA and post-editing distance adapts domain prompt and termbase, then re-translates
loops.exit: max 2 iterations or COMET score exceeds threshold

workflows.volume: 50 runs per day for a mid-size SaaS company pushing continuous documentation updates
workflows.outcome: MTPE is typically 40–60% faster and 30–50% cheaper than full human translation. Source: https://taia.io/resources/blog/ai-translation-vs-human-translation/
traps: Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base for new accounts; use DashVector or Tablestore Knowledge Storage
Do not use the standalone Machine Translation product; use Qwen-MT on Model Studio for international customers
Do not draw LINE or Telegram as guaranteed free channels without noting the $0.005 platform fee since Sept 2026
Do not use qwen-mt-uni; it is Beijing-only

workflows.title: Internal Policy RAG Assistant
workflows.ask: Build a chatbot that answers employee questions about company policies, refuses when it lacks grounding, and escalates unknown questions to HR

steps.label: Check grounding sufficiency; refuse if none
Generate answer with exact policy citations
Guardrail check for PII leaks and hallucinations
Escalate unanswered questions to policy owner
Return response or refusal to chat

human_gates: Unanswered or low-confidence questions require escalation to a human policy owner because providing an incorrect policy answer constitutes a compliance failure and potential legal risk

loops.what: Feedback capture evaluates retrieval results periodically to improve the index
loops.exit: continuous background evaluation, bounded per query to max 1 retry

workflows.volume: 1,000 runs per day for a mid-size enterprise with thousands of employees
traps: Do not use AgentBay; use agent-sandbox
Do not use Model Studio knowledge base or zero-code apps for new accounts; use Tablestore Knowledge Storage or DashVector
AgentCore IM channels are DingTalk, Lark, and WeCom only; other channels need custom adapters via webhook to FC
Do not use AI Search Open Platform; no Singapore region
AI Guardrails console supports Singapore but bills each enabled detection type separately at $6 per 10,000 calls
Do not use PAI LangStudio; it retires 2027-03-09 with no Singapore migration path
